FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.label: Children of Atom Ranks
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.drillDesc: Spar with any colonist to test their faith through combat. Both stop, stand apart, and draw their weapons. Both gain skill XP. Once per day.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.studyDesc: Study Atom's teachings with another colonist on the Confessor's path. Both gain skill XP. Once per day.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.inspectDesc: Examine a lower-ranked Zealot's weapon and armor as a rite of the faith. Well-kept gear is blessed, neglected gear is admonished.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.punishDesc: Sentence a lower-ranked Zealot to a stretch of penitent labor for a failure of devotion, souring their mood. Once per day per colonist.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.rallyDesc: Rouse every combat-ranked member of {0} on this map with a burst of speed and righteous fervor. Once every few days.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.fallInDesc: Call {0} to congregate behind you in ranks, up to four deep, interrupting whatever they're doing. They hold until dispersed.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.dismissDesc: Disperse {0} from the congregation, letting them return to their duties.
